qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग संवेदी जानकारी के लिए रिले स्टेशन के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: The thalamus processes and transmits sensory signals to the cerebral cortex. It lies in the diencephalon and relays all the sensations except smell to the cerebral cortex.

qe: The membranes that cover and protect the brain and spinal cord are called:
qh: मस्तिष्क और रीढ़ की हड्डी को ढंकने और सुरक्षित करने वाली झिल्लियाँ कहलाती हैं:
e: Meninges (Dura, Arachnoid, Pia mater) provide protection to the CNS. They cover the brain and the spinal cord, and the space between them carries the cerebro-spinal fluid.

qe: Which part of the brain regulates body temperature and hunger?
qh: मस्तिष्क का कौन सा भाग शरीर के तापमान और भूख को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: The hypothalamus is the main center for homeostasis and autonomic control. It also controls thirst, sleep, the pituitary and the autonomic nervous system, and it keeps the temperature steady.

qe: Coordination of voluntary movements and balance is the primary function of:
qh: स्वैच्छिक आंदोलनों और संतुलन का समन्वय किसका प्राथमिक कार्य है?
e: The cerebellum ensures smooth and balanced muscular activity. It also maintains the posture and the muscle tone, and its injury causes loss of balance.

qe: Joints are classified based on their structure and:
qh: जोड़ों को उनकी संरचना और किसके आधार पर वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Classification of joints depends on the degree of movement they permit. The three main groups are the fibrous, the cartilaginous and the synovial joints, and the last are freely movable.

qe: The study of surface landmarks on the human body is known as:
qh: मानव शरीर पर सतही स्थलचिह्नों के अध्ययन को कहा जाता है:
e: Surface anatomy helps in locating internal structures using external landmarks. The landmarks of the bones, muscles and vessels can be felt through the skin, and they guide the doctor in examination.

qe: Which system is responsible for motor control and voluntary actions?
qh: मोटर नियंत्रण और स्वैच्छिक क्रियाओं के लिए कौन सा तंत्र जिम्मेदार है?
e: The pyramidal system is the main pathway for voluntary motor impulses. It arises from the motor cortex and travels through the internal capsule and the spinal cord to the muscles.

qe: Which structure connects the two cerebral hemispheres?
qh: कौन सी संरचना दो सेरेब्रल हेमिस्फीयर को जोड़ती है?
e: The corpus striatum and associated fibers help in connecting brain regions. It is a thick band of nerve fibres that joins the two hemispheres and carries messages between them.

qe: Fascia and muscles of the head, neck, and face are studied to understand:
qh: सिर, गर्दन और चेहरे के प्रावरणी (Fascia) और मांसपेशियों का अध्ययन क्या समझने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Facial expressions and movements | चेहरे के भाव और गति
e: These muscles are responsible for mastication and facial communication. They help in chewing, swallowing, speech and expression, and their fascia divides the neck into compartments.

qe: Which blood vessels carry oxygenated blood away from the heart?
qh: कौन सी रक्त वाहिकाएं ऑक्सीजन युक्त रक्त को हृदय से दूर ले जाती हैं?
e: Arteries carry blood from the heart to the body, except for the pulmonary artery. They have thick elastic walls and carry blood under high pressure to all parts of the body.

qe: The double-layered membrane surrounding the lungs is called:
qh: फेफड़ों के चारों ओर की दोहरी परत वाली झिल्ली कहलाती है:
e: The pleura protects the lungs and allows for smooth movement during respiration. Its two layers glide over each other with a film of fluid, and its inflammation causes sharp pain on breathing.

qe: Which part of the respiratory system is also known as the 'Voice Box'?
qh: श्वसन तंत्र के किस भाग को 'वॉयस बॉक्स' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: The larynx contains vocal cords and is essential for sound production. It lies at the top of the windpipe, and the air passing over its cords produces the voice.

qe: Cartilage is an example of which type of tissue?
qh: कार्टिलेज किस प्रकार के ऊतक का एक उदाहरण है?
e: Cartilage provides structural support and belongs to the connective tissue group. It has a firm but flexible matrix and is found in the joints, the nose, the ear and the windpipe.

qe: The Urogenital system includes which two major systems?
qh: मूत्रजननांगी प्रणाली में कौन सी दो प्रमुख प्रणालियाँ शामिल हैं?
o: Urinary and Genital | मूत्र और जननांग प्रणाली
e: The urogenital system encompasses organs responsible for waste excretion and reproduction.

qe: Which histological component is responsible for transmitting electrical impulses?
qh: विद्युत आवेगों को प्रसारित करने के लिए कौन सा हिस्टोलॉजिकल घटक जिम्मेदार है?
e: Nerve tissue is specialized for rapid communication within the body. It is made of neurons and supporting cells, and it carries messages in the form of electrical impulses.

qe: The repair of bones after a fracture is a function studied under:
qh: फ्रैक्चर के बाद हड्डियों की मरम्मत का अध्ययन किसके अंतर्गत किया जाता है?
e: Osteology covers the formation, function, growth, and repair of bone tissue. It covers the way the broken ends are united by new bone and the factors that help or delay the healing.

qe: In computed tomography, the attenuation value of a tissue is expressed in which unit?
qh: कंप्यूटेड टोमोग्राफी में किसी ऊतक का अवशोषण मान किस इकाई में व्यक्त किया जाता है?
e: The Hounsfield scale is a calibrated grey scale in which water is taken as zero, air as about minus one thousand and dense bone as about plus one thousand. Each tissue therefore gets a number that the computer converts into the picture. It allows a small difference between pus, blood, fat and tumour to be shown clearly, which plain films cannot do.

qe: Which imaging modality uses a strong magnetic field and radio waves and does not use ionising radiation?
qh: कौन सी इमेजिंग विधि प्रबल चुंबकीय क्षेत्र और रेडियो तरंगों का उपयोग करती है और आयनकारी विकिरण का प्रयोग नहीं करती?
e: Magnetic resonance imaging places the patient in a strong magnetic field and uses radio frequency pulses to make hydrogen nuclei in the tissues give out signals which are built into images. As no X-rays are used, it is preferred for the brain, spinal cord and joints, and for pregnant women when other methods are not enough. All metal objects and implants must be removed or declared before the patient enters the room.

qe: Which is the first-choice imaging method for examining the gall bladder and the fetus because it uses sound waves?
qh: ध्वनि तरंगों का उपयोग करने के कारण पित्ताशय और भ्रूण की जाँच के लिए पहली पसंद कौन सी विधि है?
e: Ultrasound sends high frequency sound waves into the body and records the echoes from different tissues. It is safe, painless, repeatable and free of radiation, so it is used in pregnancy, gall stones, kidney stones and abdominal collections. The patient is usually asked to come fasting and with a full bladder for a pelvic scan so that the organs are seen clearly.

qe: Mammography is a special X-ray examination of which body part?
qh: मैमोग्राफी शरीर के किस भाग की विशेष एक्स-रे जाँच है?
e: Mammography uses a low energy X-ray beam with a special tube and a compression device to spread out the breast tissue, so that small nodules and micro calcifications are visible. It is the standard screening test for early breast cancer in women above forty or fifty years of age. Compression is kept firm but brief, and the dose to the gland is kept as low as possible.

qe: Which contrast medium used in MRI is based on a metal?
qh: एमआरआई में प्रयुक्त कौन सा कंट्रास्ट माध्यम किसी धातु पर आधारित है?
e: Magnetic resonance imaging uses the paramagnetic metal gadolinium, which is injected in a chelated form and changes the relaxation of nearby water protons, so certain lesions become brighter. Iodine compounds are used in X-ray and CT studies, barium sulphate is used for the gut, and air or carbon dioxide is used for double contrast examinations. Before any contrast injection the history of allergy and kidney disease must be taken.

qe: The SI unit of equivalent dose used for radiation protection of workers is:
qh: विकिरण कर्मचारियों की सुरक्षा में प्रयुक्त समतुल्य खुराक की एसआई इकाई कौन सी है?
e: The gray measures the absorbed dose, that is energy deposited per unit mass of tissue, while the sievert measures the equivalent dose, which takes into account how damaging that radiation is to living tissue. The annual limit for radiation workers is fixed at twenty millisievert averaged over five years, and the dose is monitored with a TLD badge. The becquerel, on the other hand, measures activity, that is one disintegration per second.

qe: Which device is placed between the X-ray tube and the patient to limit the field to the area of interest and reduce the dose?
qh: एक्स-रे ट्यूब और रोगी के बीच कौन सा उपकरण लगाया जाता है जो क्षेत्र को रुचि के भाग तक सीमित कर खुराक कम करता है?
e: The collimator has movable lead shutters that restrict the beam to the part being examined, so the surrounding tissues are not irradiated and the scattered radiation is less. Good collimation improves contrast as well. A grid, on the other hand, is kept between the patient and the film to absorb scattered rays, while the Bucky moves the grid during exposure to blur its shadow.

qe: In digital radiography, the X-ray image is captured on which type of device?
qh: डिजिटल रेडियोग्राफी में एक्स-रे चित्र किस प्रकार के उपकरण पर कैद किया जाता है?
o: Flat panel detector | फ्लैट पैनल डिटेक्टर
e: In direct digital radiography a flat panel detector converts the X-rays into an electric charge which is read out and sent to the computer within seconds, so the picture appears on the monitor and no dark room is needed. In computed radiography a phosphor plate is exposed and then read by a laser reader. Digital systems save time and film, and the window and brightness can be adjusted after the exposure.
